text: The formula 1/R = lim sup |cₙ|^(1/n), giving the radius of convergence R of a power series ∑ cₙ(x−a)ⁿ, is known as the ___ formula.
explanation: The book names 1/R = lim sup |cₙ|^(1/n) the Cauchy-Hadamard formula, obtained by applying the root test to cₙ(x−a)ⁿ. The ratio-test shortcut R = 1/L, with L = lim |c_(n+1)/cₙ|, only applies when that limit exists, whereas the Cauchy-Hadamard lim sup formula always works.
